architecturePlan.storeAccessPattern: Reused scripts/six-county-completeness.mjs's psql spawnSync pattern verbatim (DSN from env, never printed; default_transaction_read_only + statement_timeout set every session). Atoms-store sessions additionally set PGOPTIONS per the operational constraint.
architecturePlan.serveStateModel: Read live from hauska-engine services/retrieval-api/src/parcel-record-reader.ts (origin/main, via git show -- never checked out into the shared worktree) rather than assumed: the one-reader's serve state is a pure function of (a) engine-vendored slate membership and (b) the COUNTY-LEVEL gate verdict (parcel_gate_verdict has no place_key column -- verdicts are per county+rail, not per parcel). This instrument's own vocabulary (record/refused/legacy-transitional/not-cut-over/atom-chain/other) is a deliberate superset of the reader's three-value enum, justified per-bucket from each rail's own *FactServeCutover.ts module doc (legacy-design-tools origin/main).
architecturePlan.atomFamilyMap: P-162 (OPS-16 row, ADDED 2026-09-11, 'RAIL-TO-ATOM MAP') has not landed a code-owned map as of this build. This instrument's RAIL_TO_ATOM_FAMILY is its own provisional, evidence-based map, cross-checked against live atoms for both probe parcels before use, not assumed.
architecturePlan.queryBudget: Cell-kind counts: 12 queries total (1 county-wide + 1 city-split per county x 6), all indexed on the (place_key,rail_key) primary key's prefix range -- exact, not sampled. Atom presence/agreement for mode 2: SAMPLED, 200 parcels/county selected by `order by md5(place_key)` (the same deterministic convention scripts/vendor-testset-ctx.mjs / P-176 already uses), declared as a sample with its size and rule. road-node has no parcel-bounded index (confirmed against pg_indexes) and is declared un-sampleable at parcel grain, county-level only.
architecturePlan.heavyScanNote: No full-table scan issued against either store. Largest single query: the exact 6-county-scoped buildable-envelope no-buildable-area count (index-bounded on entity_type + the parcelNodeId partial index), ~31s. Runs sequentially, one county at a time, per the heavy-scan serialization rule; this lane holds the atoms store until its own reads finish, then releases via the atoms-reads-done marker for L-B.
